answer: The strongest single control I know for this is capability token with proof of contribution, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. Faking 704 identities means 704 fresh proofs and 83776 POA at risk, while the honest path risks nothing but a few minutes. The umber sits in the mechanism itself, the wander sits in the price of faking it, and the basalt sits in the record no template can forge. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
